name: total_mass_kg_d
description: Total fresh waste intake per day

name: organic_fraction
description: Organic (biodegradable) fraction of total fresh waste

name: suitable_fraction
description: Fraction of organic waste suitable for anaerobic digestion

name: ts_fraction
description: Total solids content of fresh feedstock (kg TS / kg fresh)

name: vs_of_ts
description: Volatile solids as fraction of total solids (kg VS / kg TS)

name: target_ts
description: Target TS concentration in digester feed slurry

name: y_biogas_nm3_per_kg_vs
description: Biogas yield per kg volatile solids destroyed

name: ch4_fraction
description: Volumetric CH4 fraction in raw biogas

name: ch4_slip
description: Methane slip (fugitive loss) fraction of produced CH4

name: availability
description: Plant annual availability / load factor

name: eta_el
description: CHP electrical efficiency (fraction of gross biogas energy)

name: eta_th
description: CHP thermal recovery efficiency (fraction of gross biogas energy)

name: eta_boiler
description: Auxiliary boiler thermal efficiency (must be > eta_th)

name: digester_temp_c
description: Mesophilic digestion target temperature (may be negative)

name: ambient_temp_c
description: Ambient incoming feed temperature (may be negative)

name: hrt_days
description: Hydraulic retention time

name: cp_kj_kg_k
description: Specific heat capacity of feedstock slurry

name: u_wall_w_m2k
description: Overall heat-transfer coefficient for digester vessel wall

name: aux_mix_kwh_m3_d
description: Mixing parasitic energy per m³ digester volume per day

name: aux_sort_kwh_t
description: Pre-sorting / pre-treatment energy per tonne of fresh waste

name: aux_gas_kwh_nm3
description: Gas handling / compression energy per Nm³ biogas

name: composition
description: Mass fractions of VS as (carbohydrates; protein; lipid) — must sum to 1
